## Language

## Your relationship to the language

- [ ] Native speaker
- [ ] Fluent / professional translator
- [ ] Learner contributing alongside a native reviewer

A native-speaker review is required for a language pack to be merged. If you are not a native speaker, please tag or recruit one to review the PR.

## What this contribution covers

- [ ] Intent YAML file (`intents/{lang}.yaml`) — voice command keywords and synonyms
- [ ] Encouragement phrase bank — varied positive feedback for milestones and clean words
- [ ] Voice catalog entry — selected Piper voice(s) with human-readable labels
- [ ] Language exclude list (e.g. characters introduced only in later lessons)
- [ ] Other (please describe)
